## Selected Portfolio Case Studies

- [NS Training EdTech Platform](https://www.qamzaka.site/case-study-ns-training.html): Online learning, course delivery, and certification UX.
- [Innovative IT Services](https://www.qamzaka.site/case-study-it-services.html): High-converting B2B technology services landing page.
- [Meta Reach & Social Distribution](https://www.qamzaka.site/case-study-meta-reach.html): 2.67M+ organic reach across Instagram and Facebook.
- [Viral YouTube Shorts Growth](https://www.qamzaka.site/case-study-shorts-growth.html): 533K+ views with 72.9% audience retention.
